_comment: GENERATED by build_config.py beside this file from the 14 Oct console build — edit the generator, not this file. The Verification Usage class and its VERIFICATION-CHECK unit are OWNED. The class is inserted Draft and activated once the unit exists (lifecycle object); DefaultUnitOfMeasureId is a forward reference, filled in after the unit is created, and destroy blanks it again before deleting the pair (README landmine: neither can be deleted while they point at each other). The unit's Type is Custom because the console form would not take Count (13 Oct). The USD unit (pre-seeded, Currency class) is only looked up: it is what RateCardEntry.RateUnitOfMeasureId points at — the form refuses the check unit there ('linked to a Token or Currency unit of measure class').
